تقترحين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِحِينَ (taqtariḥīna) /taq.ta.ri.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# تُقْتَرَحِينَ (tuqtaraḥīna) /tuq.ta.ra.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
